name: MuJoCo Playground
summary: 基于 MuJoCo MJX 的开源机器人学习环境集合，可大规模生成接触丰富的状态、动作和传感器轨迹。
summaryEn: An open-source MuJoCo MJX robot-learning suite for large-scale generation of contact-rich states, actions, and sensor trajectories.
scale: Locomotion, manipulation, and sim-to-real robot tasks
scaleZh: 运动、操作与仿真到现实机器人任务
verdict: 接触丰富机器人动力学平台
wmNote: 高吞吐物理状态与控制轨迹支持动作条件世界模型训练。
wmNoteEn: High-throughput physical states and controls support action-conditioned world-model training.
